title: Surface slab construction and relaxation
action: Construct a 3-layer (2×2) surface slab of hexagonal Ni(OH)2 terminated with the (0001) plane with 15 Å vacuum. Create the doped model by substituting one surface Ni with Fe and one with Cr. Perform spin-polarized DFT+U geometry relaxation (PBE functional, DFT-D3 dispersion, effective Hubbard U parameters as per the methodology) relaxing the top two layers while keeping the bottom layer fixed. Save the relaxed atomic coordinates.
description: Relaxed atomic coordinates for both the Ni(OH)2 and doped slabs, required for subsequent total-energy calculations.

title: DFT total-energy calculations for OER intermediates and Cl- adsorption
action: Using the relaxed slabs from step_0, compute spin-polarized DFT+U total energies for: (i) the clean surfaces, (ii) adsorbed *OH, *O, *OOH intermediates on both surfaces, (iii) gas-phase H2 and O2, and liquid H2O reference molecules, and (iv) Cl- adsorbed on at least four distinct surface metal sites (on-top) for each surface. Use the same DFT parameters as in step_0. Collect all raw total energies.
description: Raw total energies for all required configurations and reference species, serving as input to the free-energy analysis.

title: OER free-energy analysis and Cl- adsorption comparison
action: From the raw energies in dft_energies.json, apply the computational hydrogen electrode model at pH 14 to compute the Gibbs free-energy changes ΔG1–ΔG4 for each OER elementary step on Ni(OH)2 and the doped surface at potentials U = 0 V and U = 1.23 V vs RHE, using standard zero-point energy and entropy corrections for intermediates and gaseous/liquid species. Compute the site-averaged Cl- adsorption free-energy difference between the doped surface and Ni(OH)2. Write the complete set of values to dft_results.json according to the specified schema.
description: Output file containing all computed OER Gibbs free energies and the Cl- adsorption energy difference.
